originalTitle: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Sisters Novitiate | Class Reveal Trailer
content: The Sisters Novitiate class is coming to Warhammer 40,000: Darktide December 7. Wishlist now on Steam: ► Standard Edition - https://fatshark.games/rtFkua ► Deluxe Edition - https://fatshark.games/IhINq4 Sisters Novitiate stand ready to smite all who dare oppose the God-Emperor. These warriors of unwavering faith, sacred purpose and righteous zeal, will bring his wrath to the unfaithful. Whilst yet to be accepted as full Sisters within the Adepta Sororitas, their station is no measure of their might.
